name: Gareth Pryce

intro.text: Good afternoon. Gareth Pryce, Regional Director for Wales. You'll have received my email. You haven't? How odd, it was copied to everyone.
The quarry is, as of Tuesday, a Licensed Heritage Asset. You are currently an unlicensed visitor. There is a form.
I'm told battles are the quickest way to resolve a dispute. I have scheduled one. It is on the agenda, item four.

win: I see. That is a variance. I shall be logging it in the spreadsheet, and I want you to know that I am not angry. I am merely thorough.
after: The spreadsheet has a column for you now. It is not a flattering column.
